info.title: Heroes Profile API
info.description: Heroes of the Storm statistics, replay data, talent builds and player profiles.

apiKey.description: An API key from your account page, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

get.summary: Which team compositions win, and how often.

parameters.description: The client own fingerprint. Accepted and ignored: the server derives its own.
